article.story: No. 13 Iowa (8-2) at Illinois (6-4), Nov. 21 at 2:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Iowa by 7.5. Against the spread: Iowa 7-3, Illinois 6-4. How to watch: BTN Key stats Iowa Offense Overall: 379.9 yards per game (68th in FBS) Passing: 198.9 yards per game (98th) Rushing: 181 yards per game (43rd) Scoring: 27.8 points per game (69th) Iowa Defense Overall: 279.3 yards per game (10th in FBS) Passing: 195.7 yards per game (44th) Rushing: 83.6 yards per game (6th) Scoring: 11.7 points per game (1st) Illinois Offense Overall: 377 yards per game (71st in FBS) Passing: 230.8 yards per game (62nd) Rushing: 146.2 yards per game (84th) Scoring: 27 points per game (77th) Illinois Defense Overall: 375.2 yards per game (86th in FBS) Passing: 246.3 yards per game (122nd) Rushing: 128.9 yards per game (43rd) Scoring: 22.9 points per game (55th) Illinois ranks 101st in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 41.7% of the time. Iowa ranks 34th on offense, converting on 43.8% of third downs. Both teams avoid getting penalized. Iowa is 21st in the FBS averaging 43.5 penalty yards per game, and Illinois ranks 10th with a 38-yard average. Illinois is 133rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 93.9% of trips. Iowa's red zone offense ranks 59th, scoring on 86.2% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 1,504 yards, 10 TDs, 4 INTs, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 541 yards on 86 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 549 yards on 40 catches, 3 TDs Illinois Passing: Katin Houser, 2,131 yards, 18 TDs, 8 INTs, 62.2 completion percentage Rushing: Aidan Laughery, 664 yards on 116 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Collin Dixon, 946 yards on 72 catches, 13 TDs Last game Iowa beat Purdue 28-7 on Nov. 14. Brown threw for 188 yards on 20-of-29 attempts (69.0%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 10 times for 32 yards and one rushing touchdown. L.J. Phillips Jr. had 123 rushing yards on 23 carries, adding one reception for -3 yards. Braeden Jackson had four receptions for 61 yards and one touchdown. Illinois was beaten by UCLA 22-14 on Nov. 13. Houser led Illinois with 176 yards on 16-of-34 passing (47.1%) for two touchdowns and three interceptions. Laughery carried the ball 16 times for 49 yards. Hudson Clement had three receptions for 62 yards. Next game Iowa hosts Nebraska on Nov. 27. Illinois plays at Northwestern on Nov. 28.
